name: cl_pm_first_bar_cdl_15

source.title: Claude design panel 2026-10-20 (lens pm): the owner's 13:30 afternoon first-bar follow (owner_pm_first_bar_15) with the owner's own candle-rule exit, stop at the bar's other extreme and 1:1, in place of the fixed 30 / 30 bracket. Why it should pay: the first 15-minute bar after lunch shows which side the returning afternoon orders took, and a stop at that bar's far end is where that reading is wrong; the bar's own size scales the risk to the day. Who loses: traders who fade the first afternoon push back toward the lunch range.

entry.words: The first 15-minute bar of the afternoon pass (13:30-13:45 ET) closes up: buy at its close; closes down: sell. Stop at that bar's other extreme (its low for a long, its high for a short), target 1:1. Once a day, flat 15:58.

taught: [owner_pm_first_bar_15 / KN7j6NXXAio 1:33] every session open gets the same first trade: follow the first 15-minute bar; k 0.2 x ATR (the family's floor, effectively every day)
[owner 2026-10-18, cl_disp15_ema_allday_k1p5] a candle followed at its close: stop = the candle's extreme, target 1:1
[chat 2026-10-19, owner, cl_fvg_oside_15_mid_r1_t2] stop at the candle's extreme; run the same rule at 1:1
[Claude design panel 2026-10-20] the owner's candle exit applied to the 13:30 first-bar follow, nothing else changed
not_run: THE STOP: the 13:30-13:45 bar's other extreme, floored at 0.25 x ATR when nearer; its size differs from day to day (the 30 / 30 sheet's neighbours showed wider stops doing better: $40 at 30 / 30, $74 at 37.5 / 37.5).
THE 13:30 START: the engine's afternoon pass, not JJ's 14:00 (as owner_pm_first_bar_15).
THE UNSEEN DAYS: owner_pm_first_bar_15 (the same entries with a 30 / 30 bracket) had its 3:1 block walk-forward read on 2026-10-20 00:30 ET; these entries are therefore partly seen.
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage, $4 a round turn, tick replay).
THE TEST DAYS (2025-07-01 on) ARE NOT READ by this sheet: build days only.
FLAT: every trade is flat by 15:58 ET (13:13 on half days).
